analysis.title: GS - Laicini - Prime HFs Update - Yesterday and Intraday Today - 5 Nov 2026
key_insights: On Nov 4, broader markets rose, but a semis-to-software rotation drove a sharp US momentum sell-off.
Systematic L/S funds ended Nov 4 slightly up as EM Asia gains offset US losses.
Global fundamental funds rose on Nov 4 on the broad market rally. Multi-strategy funds were modestly lower.
Intraday Nov 5 (about 10:30 EST): US markets sold off and global momentum fell. Fundamental funds were down, with US-focused funds hit harder.
TMT exposure was severely down intraday on Nov 5. Systematic funds were positive. Multi-strategy funds were down significantly on their equity exposure.
risk_factors: Momentum unwind in US equities tied to rotation out of semis, continuing intraday Nov 5.
TMT-heavy hedge fund exposure is driving losses in US-focused fundamental and multi-strategy funds.
vol_and_positioning: Nov 4: a semis-to-software rotation drove a sharp US momentum sell-off while broader markets rose.
Nov 4 hedge fund performance: systematic L/S slightly up, global fundamentals up, multi-strategy modestly lower.
Nov 5 intraday (~10:30 EST): global momentum down, fundamentals down with US-focused funds hit harder, TMT severely down, systematics positive, multi-strategy down significantly on equity exposure.
